map.💡 及时率 = 5 分钟内响应量 ÷ 咨询总量 × 100%；超时量 = 咨询总: 💡 On-time rate = responses within 5 minutes ÷ total enquiries × 100%; overdue count = total enquiries − on-time responses; an on-time rate below 90% means more agents are needed.

map.示例：会话 500、总响应 25000 秒，平均 50 秒；解决 460，解决率: Example: 500 sessions with 25000 seconds of total response time gives an average of 50 seconds; 460 resolved gives a 92% resolution rate.
